qwen3-32b-h200-sglang-chunked-prefill.attribution: Chunked prefill: engine.afd.chunked_prefill_size=256 < isl=1024 splits each prompt into 4 chunks on SGLang's native chunked-prefill path. Each prefill pass is priced by the aic-afd provider at its actual (chunk tokens, prefix) geometry (attention grows with the real prefix, F-pool cost tracks chunk tokens) — never a full frozen prompt step. The caliber change is physical, not an error: TTFT pays one full pipeline step per chunk (fill included, conservative per-pass fill — see the fill-amortized case), and decode interleaves with chunk passes (mean_tpot_ms roughly doubles vs the pinned single-pass case). Default behavior is unchanged: without an explicit chunked_prefill_size the window stays pinned at the prompt length.
qwen3-32b-h200-sglang-chunked-prefill.modeling_change: Ordered-stage simulation replaces count-selected overlap formulas. Four independent stages or two continuous resource groups start empty and drain every pass; frozen decode averages per-sample billed latencies. The previous amortized case now exercises two_stage.

qwen3-32b-h200-sglang-pd-prefill.attribution: afd+pd on the continuous SGLang core: the AFD pool serves one phase as a disagg role (aic-afd provider injected via PerfModel::External) paired with a monolithic companion on the generic DestinationFirst handoff surface (backend sglang 0.5.14, h200_sxm). Caliber note: the generic destination convention produces ALL osl tokens at the destination (the source-side first-token signal marks TTFT/conformance only and is not counted in report totals), so an AFD decode role runs one more decode pass per request than the retired Python island's osl-1 convention; TTFT includes the first destination decode pass. Per-worker GPU accounting reports the A/F pool-pair total (16) on the AFD role and tp (8) on the companion. Same data caveat as the pure case: h200_sxm sglang lacks mla_bmm rows (trtllm 1.3.0rc20 fallback, warned at load).
qwen3-32b-h200-sglang-pd-prefill.modeling_change: Ordered-stage simulation replaces count-selected overlap formulas. Four independent stages or two continuous resource groups start empty and drain every pass; frozen decode averages per-sample billed latencies. The previous amortized case now exercises two_stage.

qwen3-32b-h200-sglang-pure-both.attribution: Continuous-batching rebuild: the AFD pool now runs on the SGLang continuous scheduler (mid-flight admission + retraction) with the aic-afd timing provider injected, anchoring the sglang perf-DB family (0.5.14); the retired batch-locked AfdCore + trtllm anchor is not comparable and was dropped (mean_ttft_ms 422.1866311464918 / mean_tpot_ms 11.846695674852583 at a_batch_size=18). The afd+pd cases (pd-decode / pd-prefill) run on the same continuous core with a monolithic companion. One data caveat: the h200_sxm sglang family lacks mla_bmm rows, so that op family falls back to trtllm 1.3.0rc20 data (framework-implicit, warned at load).
qwen3-32b-h200-sglang-pure-both.modeling_change: Ordered-stage simulation replaces count-selected overlap formulas. qwen3-32b-h200-sglang-pure-both-saturate.attribution: Saturated admission anchor: identical topology, backend_version and perf-DB family to qwen3-32b-h200-sglang-pure-both, with concurrency 24 pushed above the pool's in-flight cap (max_num_seqs = n_a_workers 1 * a_batch_size 18 = 18) and 64 total requests, so every pass has work queued. Pins the saturated side of the admission boundary that the unsaturated case cannot reach: the radix memory reserve must not bind below max_num_seqs, each 1024-token prompt must pre-fill in a single pass at the derived prompt window (the AFD timing identity charges one frozen prefill step per pass), and no retraction may fire across the whole run. Companion scheduler-level evidence: continuous_afd_derivation_keeps_max_num_seqs_as_the_only_binding_limit in crates/core/src/engine/scheduler/sglang/tests.rs. Not an anchor for the microbatch geometry clamp: a_batch_size 18 / num_microbatches 3 divides evenly, so the saturated short-circuit and the legacy clamp path price this workload identically.
qwen3-32b-h200-sglang-pure-both-saturate.modeling_change: Ordered-stage simulation replaces count-selected overlap formulas. Four independent stages or two continuous resource groups start empty and drain every pass; frozen decode averages per-sample billed latencies. The previous amortized case now exercises two_stage.

qwen3-32b-h200-sglang-two-stage.attribution: Two shared resources execute A + A_to_F and F + F_to_A continuously per microbatch. Every pass includes startup, waiting and drain time. This case replaces the retired fill-amortized fixture; its original description is retained as historical attribution.
historical_attribution: Pipeline fill amortization (non-default caliber knob): pipeline_fill_mode=amortized prices steady-state decode passes at cycle terms only — the pipeline fill is charged on the first decode pass (startup) and on instantaneous boundary passes (m' below the configured depth). TTFT is unchanged (prefill keeps per-pass fill); TPOT drops ~1.2% vs the per_pass case for this geometry (fill is a small share of the stride-averaged step). Compare qwen3-32b-h200-sglang-pure-both for the conservative default.
qwen3-32b-h200-sglang-two-stage.modeling_change: Two-stage resource layout replaces the retired amortized fixture. Each pass starts empty and drains all microbatches using the shared ordered-stage simulator.
